title: Dasakam 35 — Śrīrāmāvatāram
description: The poet recounts Rama’s alliance with Sugriva, the search for Sita, the Lanka campaign, Rama’s return and later events, then closes with a prayer to Guruvayurappan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
नीतः सुग्रीवमैत्रीं तदनु हनुमता दुन्दुभेः कायमुच्चैः
क्षिप्त्वाङ्गुष्ठेन भूयो लुलुविथ युगपत् पत्रिणा सप्तसालान् ।
हत्वा सुग्रीवघातोद्यतमतुलबलं वालिनं व्याजवृत्त्या
वर्षावेलामनैषीर्विरहतरलितस्त्वं मतङ्गाश्रमान्ते ॥ ३५-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nītaḥ sugrīvamaitrīṃ tadanu hanumatā dundubheḥ kāyamuccaiḥ
kṣiptvāṅguṣṭhena bhūyo luluvitha yugapat patriṇā saptasālān |
hatvā sugrīvaghātodyatamatulabalaṃ vālinaṃ vyājavṛttyā
varṣāvelāmanaiṣīrvirahataralitastvaṃ mataṅgāśramānte || 35-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Rama got introduced to Sugreeva by Hanuman, who agrees to help Rama, if he helps him win against Vali. Rama flung the body of Asura Dhundubi with his toe  and pierced row of seven shala trees with one arrow, to prove his might to Sugreeva. He then killed mighty Vali, standing behind the tree. Rama stayed in the Matanga Muni ashrama during the entire rainy season tormented by the separation of wife Seetha.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सुग्रीवेणानुजोक्त्या सभयमभियता व्यूहितां वाहिनीं ता-
-मृक्षाणां वीक्ष्य दिक्षु द्रुतमथ दयितामार्गणायावनम्राम् ।
सन्देशं चाङ्गुलीयं पवनसुतकरे प्रादिशो मोदशाली
मार्गे मार्गे ममार्गे कपिभिरपि तदा त्वत्प्रिया सप्रयासैः ॥ ३५-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sugrīveṇānujoktyā sabhayamabhiyatā vyūhitāṃ vāhinīṃ tā-
-mṛkṣāṇāṃ vīkṣya dikṣu drutamatha dayitāmārgaṇāyāvanamrām |
sandeśaṃ cāṅgulīyaṃ pavanasutakare prādiśo modaśālī
mārge mārge mamārge kapibhirapi tadā tvatpriyā saprayāsaiḥ || 35-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: At the prompting by Lakshmana, Sugreeva sent his army of monkeys to search for Seetha. Hanuman received Signet ring and a message from Rama and set out on his search mission.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वद्वार्ताकर्णनोद्यद्गरुदुरुजवसम्पातिसम्पातिवाक्य-
-प्रोत्तीर्णार्णोधिरन्तर्नगरि जनकजां वीक्ष्य दत्त्वाऽङ्गुलीयम् ।
प्रक्षुद्योद्यानमक्षक्षपणचणरणः सोढबन्धो दशास्यं
दृष्ट्वा प्लुष्ट्वा च लङ्कां झटिति स हनुमान् मौलिरत्नं ददौ ते ॥ ३५-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvadvārtākarṇanodyadgarudurujavasampātisampātivākya-
-prottīrṇārṇodhirantarnagari janakajāṃ vīkṣya dattvā’ṅgulīyam |
prakṣudyodyānamakṣakṣapaṇacaṇaraṇaḥ soḍhabandho daśāsyaṃ
dṛṣṭvā pluṣṭvā ca laṅkāṃ jhaṭiti sa hanumān mauliratnaṃ dadau te || 35-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Sampaathi grew its wings and flew higher and faster and found Seetha in Lanka with its long and distant vision. Hanuman leaped across the ocean and located her in Ashokavana, gave the ring and took choodamani in return. Hamuman met Ravana and agitated with the insult made by him, set fire and burned Lanka. Hanuman returned to ashrama quickly and gave information about Seetha and her choodamani to Rama.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वं सुग्रीवाङ्गदादिप्रबलकपिचमूचक्रविक्रान्तभूमी-
-चक्रोऽभिक्रम्य पारे जलधि निशिचरेन्द्रानुजाश्रीयमाणः ।
तत्प्रोक्तां शत्रुवार्तां रहसि निशमयन् प्रार्थनापार्थ्यरोष-
-प्रास्ताग्नेयास्त्रतेजस्त्रसदुदधिगिरा लब्धवान् मध्यमार्गम् ॥ ३५-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvaṃ sugrīvāṅgadādiprabalakapicamūcakravikrāntabhūmī-
-cakro’bhikramya pāre jaladhi niśicarendrānujāśrīyamāṇaḥ |
tatproktāṃ śatruvārtāṃ rahasi niśamayan prārthanāpārthyaroṣa-
-prāstāgneyāstratejastrasadudadhigirā labdhavān madhyamārgam || 35-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana surrendered to Rama and helped in giving information about his brother's secret tactics in warfare. Samudra Rajan refused to heed to Rama's request to give way even after three days. Rama got angry and was about to pierce it with Fire missile. Scared by its effects, Samudra Rajan gave way.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कीशैराशान्तरोपाहृतगिरिनिकरैः सेतुमाधाप्य यातो
यातून्यामर्द्य दंष्ट्रानखशिखरिशिलासालशस्त्रैः स्वसैन्यैः ।
व्याकुर्वन् सानुजस्त्वं समरभुवि परं विक्रमं शक्रजेत्रा
वेगान्नागास्त्रबद्धः पतगपतिगरुन्मारुतैर्मोचितोऽभूः ॥ ३५-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kīśairāśāntaropāhṛtagirinikaraiḥ setumādhāpya yāto
yātūnyāmardya daṃṣṭrānakhaśikhariśilāsālaśastraiḥ svasainyaiḥ |
vyākurvan sānujastvaṃ samarabhuvi paraṃ vikramaṃ śakrajetrā
vegānnāgāstrabaddhaḥ patagapatigarunmārutairmocito’bhūḥ || 35-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Soon Monkeys built a bridge across the ocean with mountains, stones and logs.  Reaching Lanka, Monkeys attacked rakshashas with teeth, claws and mountains but sooner Indrajit, son of Ravana tied Rama and Lakshmana with Nagasthra. Garuda came flapping his wings immediately, releasing both of them.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सौमित्रिस्त्वत्र शक्तिप्रहृतिगलदसुर्वातजानीतशैल-
-घ्राणात् प्राणानुपेतो व्यकृणुत कुसृतिश्लाघिनं मेघनादम् ।
मायाक्षोभेषु वैभीषणवचनहृतस्तम्भनः कुम्भकर्णं
सम्प्राप्तं कम्पितोर्वीतलमखिलचमूभक्षिणं व्यक्षिणोस्त्वम् ॥ ३४-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
saumitristvatra śaktiprahṛtigaladasurvātajānītaśaila-
-ghrāṇāt prāṇānupeto vyakṛṇuta kusṛtiślāghinaṃ meghanādam |
māyākṣobheṣu vaibhīṣaṇavacanahṛtastambhanaḥ kumbhakarṇaṃ
samprāptaṃ kampitorvītalamakhilacamūbhakṣiṇaṃ vyakṣiṇostvam || 34-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Ravana got furious and attacked Lakshmana with shakti missile. Lakshmana's breath was slowly slipping of his body and fell unconscious and was revived by herbs of Sanjeevini mountain brought by mighty Hanuman. Lakshmana killed Indrajit and Rama killed Kumbakarna, brother of Ravana.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गृह्णन् जम्भारिसम्प्रेषितरथकवचौ रावणेनाभियुध्यन्
ब्रह्मास्त्रेणास्य भिन्दन् गलततिमबलामग्निशुद्धां प्रगृह्णन् ।
देवश्रेणीवरोज्जीवितसमरमृतैरक्षतैरृक्षसङ्घै-
-र्लङ्काभर्त्रा च साकं निजनगरमगाः सप्रियः पुष्पकेण ॥ ३५-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gṛhṇan jambhārisampreṣitarathakavacau rāvaṇenābhiyudhyan
brahmāstreṇāsya bhindan galatatimabalāmagniśuddhāṃ pragṛhṇan |
devaśreṇīvarojjīvitasamaramṛtairakṣatairṛkṣasaṅghai-
-rlaṅkābhartrā ca sākaṃ nijanagaramagāḥ sapriyaḥ puṣpakeṇa || 35-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Rama fought with Ravana and killed him by cutting off his row of heads by Brahmasthra. Rama accepted Seetha Maatha after she was purified by fire God and returned to Ayodya in a Pushpaka Vimanam along with Vibheeshana, Hanuman and army of monkeys.

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रीतो दिव्याभिषेकैरयुतसमधिकान् वत्सरान् पर्यरंसी-
-र्मैथिल्यां पापवाचा शिव शिव किल तां गर्भिणीमभ्यहासीः ।
शत्रुघ्नेनार्दयित्वा लवणनिशिचरं प्रार्दयः शूद्रपाशं
तावद्वाल्मीकिगेहे कृतवसतिरुपासूत सीतासुतौ ते ॥ ३५-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prīto divyābhiṣekairayutasamadhikān vatsarān paryaraṃsī-
-rmaithilyāṃ pāpavācā śiva śiva kila tāṃ garbhiṇīmabhyahāsīḥ |
śatrughnenārdayitvā lavaṇaniśicaraṃ prārdayaḥ śūdrapāśaṃ
tāvad vālmīkigehe kṛtavasatirupāsūta sītāsutau te || 35-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Sage Vashishtar conducted Pattabhishekam for Rama and Seetha couple and Rama ruled the kingdom for more than 11,000 years. Rama sent Seetha Maa to exile. Seetha lived in Valmiki ashrama and gave birth to twin sons Luva and Kusha.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वाल्मीकेस्त्वत्सुतोद्गापितमधुरकृतेराज्ञया यज्ञवाटे
सीतां त्वय्याप्तुकामे क्षितिमविशदसौ त्वं च कालार्थितोऽभूः ।
हेतोः सौमित्रिघाती स्वयमथ सरयूमग्ननिश्शेषभृत्यैः
साकं नाकं प्रयातो निजपदमगमो देव वैकुण्ठमाद्यम् ॥ ३५-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vālmīkestvatsutodgāpitamadhurakṛterājñayā yajñavāṭe
sītāṃ tvayyāptukāme kṣitimaviśadasau tvaṃ ca kālārthito’bhūḥ |
hetoḥ saumitrighātī svayamatha sarayūmagnaniśśeṣabhṛtyaiḥ
sākaṃ nākaṃ prayāto nijapadamagamo deva vaikuṇṭhamādyam || 35-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Sage Valmiki attended Rama’s Ashwamedha Yagam with Luva and Kusha and made them render Ramayana sweetly. Rama want to take back Seetha, but Seetha Maa called her Mother Divine Earth and entered Earth. Rama rested the responsibility of Kingdom with his sons and sacrificed Lakshmana and departed the earth by submerging in to river Sarayu and reached Vaikunta.

stanzas.sanskrit:
सोऽयं मर्त्यावतारस्तव खलु नियतं मर्त्यशिक्षार्थमेवं
विश्लेषार्तिर्निरागस्त्यजनमपि भवेत् कामधर्मातिसक्त्या ।
नो चेत् स्वात्मानुभूतेः क्व नु तव मनसो विक्रिया चक्रपाणे
स त्वं सत्त्वैकमूर्ते पवनपुरपते व्याधुनु व्याधितापान् ॥ ३५-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
so’yaṃ martyāvatārastava khalu niyataṃ martyaśikṣārthamevaṃ
viśleṣārtirnirāgastyajanamapi bhavet kāmadharmātisaktyā |
no cet svātmānubhūteḥ kva nu tava manaso vikriyā cakrapāṇe
sa tvaṃ sattvaikamūrte pavanapurapate vyādhunu vyādhitāpān || 35-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattadiri says that Rama, is to teach Mankind that excessive attachement to beings or things will lead only to sacrifice and suffering of innocent souls. He requests Bhagwan who taught this truth to the world through his Rama avathar to cure the world of all afflictions.
